entities.text: High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to stay all proceedings pursuant on Ext P7 communication of the  2nd respondent, and to direct the 1st respondent to return possession  ofthe acquired properties to the petitioner until such time as the  requirements of S. 94 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency  in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been  actually complied with, pending disposal of the above writ petition.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency  in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's order dated  12.06.2024 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S. ANIL SIVARAMAN,
 RAJIVINCENT & JOTHISHA K.A., Advocates for the petitioner, GOVERNMENT  PLEADER for the respondents 1 and 2 and of SMT.RASHMITA RAMACHANDRAN,
 Advocate for the 3rd respondent, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Post on 14-08-2024.
Inteirm order is extended till then.
